title: Prez #3 #4 Lot DC Comics 2015 Mark Russell Ben Caldwell Beth Ross Teen President
condition_description: Both bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Lot of 2: Prez #3 (October 2015) and #4 (November 2015), DC Comics - Beth Ross, the first teen president of the United States. Written by Mark Russell, art and covers by Ben Caldwell, with Mark Morales and Jeremy Lawson. Rated T. Direct sales, $2.99 cover price each.

Back covers: #3 Snickers ad; #4 Moonbeam City (Comedy Central) ad.

Condition: both bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
